taggedPubkey.name: taggedPubkey
taggedPubkey.title: Tagged Pubkey
taggedPubkey.description: The 64-char hex pubkey of the nostr user being tagged. Mirrors the event's `p` tag.

tagEventId.name: tagEventId
tagEventId.title: Tag Event ID
tagEventId.description: The event ID of the kind 39999 tag element being applied. Mirrors the event's `e` tag.

tagAddress.name: tagAddress
tagAddress.title: Tag Address
tagAddress.description: Optional. The addressable coordinate `39999:<tagAuthorPubkey>:<slug>` of the tag element being applied (its stable identity). Mirrors the event's `a` tag (ADR-0022 hybrid e+a). Absent on legacy e-only assertions.
